#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>

int main() {
    int totalNumbers, maxBudget;
    std::cin >> totalNumbers >> maxBudget;

    std::vector<int> numbers(totalNumbers);
    std::vector<int> prefixBalance(totalNumbers);
    int balance = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < totalNumbers; ++i) {
        std::cin >> numbers[i];
        if (numbers[i] % 2 == 0)
            ++balance;
        else
            --balance;
        prefixBalance[i] = balance;
    }

    std::vector<int> differences;
    for (int i = 0; i < totalNumbers - 1; ++i) {
        if (prefixBalance[i] == 0) {
            differences.push_back(std::abs(numbers[i] - numbers[i + 1]));
        }
    }

    std::sort(differences.begin(), differences.end());

    int totalCuts = 0;
    int currentSum = 0;
    for (int diff : differences) {
        if (currentSum + diff <= maxBudget) {
            currentSum += diff;
            ++totalCuts;
        }
        if (currentSum >= maxBudget) {
            break;
        }
    }

    std::cout << totalCuts;
    return 0;
}
